Mimica is the first and only task mining platform that records natively on both macOS and Windows. 
Team members working on a Mac can install the Mimica Recorder directly on their own machine. No Windows laptop, no virtual environment, no workaround needed. 
For any department that runs on Apple hardware, that's rare in this category.
Why this matters
Most task mining tools assume a Windows environment. That excludes a specific slice of the enterprise: teams in tech, media, financial services, and creative industries where Apple hardware is standard, not the exception.
The impact goes beyond inconvenience. Without native macOS support, mixed teams can only capture partial data, because Mac-based employees sit out of every recording project. 
Who this is for
Teams running on Mac: SMEs on Mac record exactly as their Windows colleagues do, using their own hardware, with no setup gymnastics.‍
Programs ready to expand: If you're already running Mimica and want to bring in a Mac-heavy department, you can do that today. ‍
Anyone evaluating Mimica: If macOS support was ever a blocker with another platform, it isn't one here. Run a proof of concept with your actual SMEs on their actual machines.
Full access, not a workaround
The Mimica Recorder installs as a native macOS app, delivering process maps, step-level data, and screenshots at the same level as Windows recordings.
This isn't a scaled-down version built for macOS. It's the exact same app.
Windows and Mac users can record into the same project side by side. Teams don't need to split into separate workstreams by operating system, and the data comes back as one coherent picture of how work actually happens, not two.
Available now for every enterprise
The macOS Recorder is now available to every Mimica user. 
Mimica is built to capture how work actually happens, regardless of which computer someone happens to use. That completeness is the point, and right now, it's something no other task mining provider can match.
